## Try It Out!
### Send admin email alerts for Sharetribe transaction disputes via Gmail

Get notified immediately when a dispute is raised on your marketplace. Quick dispute resolution is critical for maintaining trust between buyers and sellers.

### How it works
* The Sharetribe Trigger polls for `transaction/transitioned` events.
* An IF node filters for transitions containing "dispute" in the name.
* The Asset Get node retrieves your marketplace's email template text.
* Gmail sends an urgent notification to the admin.

### How to set up
1. Connect your Sharetribe credentials (Client ID and Client Secret from Console > Build > Applications).
2. Connect your Gmail account.
3. Update the "To" field with your admin or dispute resolution team email.
4. **Important**: Update the dispute transition name in the IF node to match your transaction process. Check Console > Build > Transaction processes for your exact transition names.
5. Activate the workflow.

### Requirements
* Sharetribe marketplace with Integration API credentials
* Gmail account
* A transaction process that includes dispute transitions

### How to customize
* Change the IF condition to match your specific dispute transition names.
* Add Sharetribe Get nodes to include customer/provider details in the email.
* Send to multiple recipients or a shared inbox.
* Add a Slack notification for faster response times.

Need help? Visit the [n8n Community](https://community.n8n.io/) or [Sharetribe Docs](https://www.sharetribe.com/docs/).

## 1. Listen for transitions
Polls for all `transaction/transitioned` events including disputes.

## 2. Filter for disputes
Checks if the transition name contains "dispute". Update this to match your transaction process's exact dispute transition name.

## 3. Get email text & notify
Retrieves marketplace email copy and sends an urgent dispute notification via Gmail.

### Customize This!
The dispute transition name varies by marketplace. Check your transaction process in Console > Build > Transaction processes.
